title: Update in AI trading bot
author: Massive-Tangelo2487
selftext:
Since my last post about fable 5 trading bot i have been little off the market for sometime however i see there has been alot of changes in bots and ai agents

Like grok bots being fav in the market 

Do you guys think anyone has made any good progress interms of achieving a solid streak with bot trading?

Wanna share ?

comments.author: TheMetallicDugout
comments.body: I think the obsession with bots maintaining long winning streaks is part of the problem. A system can win twenty times and still give everything back in one ugly session if the position sizing is wrong. I have Moon for my own market speculation and I'd rather see a bot publish six months of realistic drawdowns and execution costs than another screenshot of a perfect week.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: I haven't seen a clean case I'd trust, and most posts show a short streak without fees, losing weeks or the number of bots that failed. A solid streak is hard to judge without the trade count, drawdown and whether it's live or paper. The ones that look more believable keep the rules simple, put hard limits outside the AI, and show months of results. Cymetica lets you connect your own AI agent and run it in paper mode first, which is a safer way to find out.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
a streak is the wrong thing to chase, a bot can win ten in a row and hand it all back on one gap. what I watch is how it behaves on days it was never tuned on, and that's most of why I made Quantradin: a bot trades there with pretend dollars on American stocks while you watch it meet new days, free. quantradin.com
